description: Verification contracts per PS2 hardware/runtime component (ids from docs/status/components.json). Hand-written; a contract states what correct means for the component, independently of how it is implemented. Fields with no known answer say 'unknown'. Checked by tools/hwcoverage/hwcoverage.py; coverage of contracts is reported as the contract_specified level.

gs.dither.block: GS pixel pipeline, post-blend colour stage

registers.DIMX (0x44): 16 elements DMyx, 3 bits each at bit 4*(4*y+x), bit 4*(4*y+x)+3 unused; signed range -4..3

functional_requirements: With DTHE=1, DMyx for (x mod 4, y mod 4) of the written pixel is added to R, G and B; alpha is unchanged
The addition happens after alpha blending and before COLCLAMP
Dithering affects frame buffers stored in a 16-bit format (PSMCT16/PSMCT16S) when the 8-bit result is reduced to 5 bits
gs.dither.reset_state: DIMX and DTHE zero after GS reset (PCSX2 GSDrawingEnvironment::Reset); hardware value unknown
gs.dither.read_write_semantics: write-only GS general registers via GIF A+D or PACKED; not readable by the EE
gs.dither.timing: no timing obligation beyond pixel order
acceptance: Unit test: every matrix position, sign handling (-4 vs -1), 4-pixel repetition, order relative to COLCLAMP, no effect with DTHE=0
Hardware: GS frame captures of a dither probe (flat colour quads in PSMCT16 and PSMCT32 over a known DIMX) match bit for bit
references: PCSX2 f0523f8: GSRegs.h GIFRegDIMX, GSState.h ExpandDIMX, GSDrawScanline.cpp WriteFrame
gs.dither.known_divergences: PCSX2 and DobieStation disagree on the element encoding and on whether 32-bit buffers are dithered (decision D-GS-1); unresolved without hardware

gs.alpha.block: GS pixel pipeline, alpha blending and colour clamp

registers.ALPHA_1/2 (0x42/0x43): A, B, C, D selectors and FIX: Cv = ((A - B) * C >> 7) + D
registers.PABE (0x49): bypass blending for source alpha with MSB clear
registers.COLCLAMP (0x46): bit 0: 1 saturates to 0..255, 0 keeps the low 8 bits

functional_requirements: Blend on signed intermediate values without clamping
COLCLAMP selects saturation or wrap after blending and dithering
PABE and FBA as specified per register
gs.alpha.reset_state: COLCLAMP zero after GS reset (PCSX2); the SDK environment sets it to 1
acceptance: Unit tests: saturation and wrap in both directions, PABE, FBA
Hardware: GS frame captures of blend probes
gs.alpha.known_divergences: none between the two references for COLCLAMP
